purpose: Preserve preproduction red-team defect history across the controlled v2-to-v3 authoritative database rebuild.

defects.description: Final QA filtered nonterminal leaf/batch failures and could mass-promote untouched rows.
defects.observed_result: NOT_STARTED and IN_PROGRESS scopes were eligible for blanket QA_PASSED update.
defects.required_correction: Nonterminal states remain blocking; promote only exact INTEGRITY_CHECKED candidates after an eligible-versus-active guard.
defects.same_pattern_search_requirement: All promotion paths, product sources and batches.

defects.description: Record identity collapsed repeated identical callout rows.
defects.observed_result: Two visible callout-4 occurrences became one record.
defects.required_correction: Stage every visible source-row occurrence with section, exact anchor and occurrence ordinal before one-to-one record creation.

defects.description: Unbounded product-card context could copy a neighbouring row's part number into a missing-number row.
defects.observed_result: Model 300 Bracket could receive the next product's number.
defects.required_correction: Bound each card at the next structural row marker and hash the exact evidence snippet.
defects.same_pattern_search_requirement: Every source card and detail merge.

defects.description: Byte verification could falsely set record association verified without rechecking the source occurrence.
defects.observed_result: Correct bytes attached to a wrong record could pass.
defects.required_correction: Store immutable source-page hash, exact occurrence locator and explicit many-to-many associations; audit association independently from bytes.
defects.same_pattern_search_requirement: All product, selector, active-diagram and gallery images.

defects.description: Partial renderer output could be mislabeled NO_OEM_IMAGE_AVAILABLE.
defects.observed_result: A fitment-only page with no gallery markers appeared image-empty.
defects.required_correction: Require complete product markers before no-image disposition; retry product pages through inner HTTPS with X-No-Cache.
defects.same_pattern_search_requirement: All product sources with zero images.

defects.description: Schema foreign keys proved existence but not variation/category/leaf context consistency.
defects.observed_result: Cross-variation taxonomy and record associations were schema-permitted.
defects.required_correction: Add composite candidate keys and fail-closed context triggers; rebuild from preserved source snapshots.
defects.same_pattern_search_requirement: Taxonomy parents, leaves, records and image associations.

defects.description: Initial route category counts changed by exactly two categories on every controlled route.
defects.observed_result: Baseline total 1081; two independent current renderer schemes agree on total 1069.
defects.required_correction: Preserve baseline counts and write a dated current route-revalidation manifest controlling active extraction.
